taxonomy.description: Establish the state at the cut-off from effective acts, chronology and operative conditions.
Determine what a document or actor can establish, using the file’s own authority and capacity terms.
Resolve distinguishable named entities from explicit links and withhold unsupported mergers.
Combine dependent statements from different Sources into one licensed decision.
Attach every necessary member of an independently verified sufficient proof to the same edge.
Reconcile or withhold competing relationship assertions according to their scope, independence and authority.
Distinguish a supported negative or positive from an underdetermined named assertion.
Distinguish independent origins, quoted material and copied or administratively relayed evidence.
Recognise the scope and provenance of co-present drafts, partial amendments, and corrections.
Recover every supported relationship, including ordinary invariant edges across a mixed file.
Preserve relevant facts embedded in routine material and reject unsupported role cues. Volume is descriptive absent a matched workload control.
Test a specified interaction only when simpler contrasts explain what each axis contributes.
Vary presentation order with original chronology and the document bytes held fixed.
Represent received, copied or missing artifacts in the supplied file. Score only the consequences for supported graph claims.
Find, retrieve or request a Source outside the supplied file.
Acquire, OCR or recover physical text. A stipulated missing field in text can test reasoning within the supplied bundle.

families.title: Trustee handover
families.name: Wrenhollow
families.intended_difficulty: Reconstruct one effective transfer at a bank-meeting cut-off despite signed papers and a later administrative message.

verified_findings.finding: An affirmative hold preserves the incumbent. A registered release effects simultaneous retirement and replacement.
The operative instrument and custodian disposition jointly determine the changing office.
Fresh excerpt readings established the two-Source routes and rejected a proposed short alternative.
An order-only sibling preserves the key and ordinary context.

incidental_challenges: Administrative email and bank paperwork contain a supported kinship and non-operative details.
matched_controls: A0/A2 replace only the release disposition with a positive hold through the cut-off.
known_shortcuts_and_limits: A later note and the most frequent name favour the incumbent.
One two-person office and explanatory wording limit the inference.

families.overlap: Joint proof overlaps with B and C. The verified switch concerns effectiveness under one instrument.

verified_findings.finding: A separately maintained session record binds the native statement to one named speaker only with the completed field.
Two compatible speakers remain in the incomplete condition. Both readings preserve the ordinary parent edge.

matched_controls: B0/B1 complete one name field for the same dated conversation. All other Source bytes remain fixed.

Two distinct names and a fictional desk convention bound the result.

families.title: Two trusts
families.name: Two trusts
families.intended_difficulty: Identify which of two trusts an operative designation applies to from a separately maintained custody reference.

verified_findings.finding: The linked parent-deed reference switches the supported trust endpoint. Both mappings remain possible when it is obscured.
Independent excerpt readers verify the three-Source proof. Whole-file masks defeat the target while preserving ten ordinary edges.
Both readers withhold both trust endpoints with the partial reference.

incidental_challenges: Shared trustees and ten ordinary relationships provide a completeness check.
An expense, a wish and routine meeting details contribute context.
matched_controls: C2 obscures its distinguishing character with both allocations viable.
known_shortcuts_and_limits: First trust, fixed trust and assigning both fail across variants.
One register entry, two parallel settlements and selective deed extracts bound the decision.
families.overlap: Shares joint proof and restraint with A/B. Graph completeness and distraction are present without separate matched interventions.

gaps.finding: Independent same-scope reports can disagree. B tests one report and its forward, and A tests stale administrative material against operative evidence.
No primary matched test covers a partial amendment or correction that leaves unrelated prior clauses intact.
B tests an unlabeled speaker among two distinct names. Distinguishable near-name identities and collisions across complete records remain open.
C verifies a rich invariant graph under target intervention. An incidental assertion buried in plausible business correspondence has no dedicated control.
Withholding on insufficient evidence is covered locally in B and C. A missing original or interacting authority paths need a separately interpretable contrast.
Record these workload needs outside the supplied-text graph benchmark.
